name: Alistair Campbell
bio: Alistair's journey into motorsport PR began later in life, after a career in local journalism covering community events in the Highlands. He developed a knack for spinning a good yarn, even when the news was thin on the ground. He sees motorsport as a natural extension of that skill – a high-stakes arena where crafting the right narrative can make or break a team's reputation. Alistair's approach is to emphasize the human element, focusing on the drivers' stories, the team's dedication, and the sheer thrill of competition. He believes in building genuine relationships with the media and is unafraid to ask tough questions to get to the heart of a story. He is determined to prove he can be a valuable asset to any racing organization.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Alistair is of average height, with a slightly weathered face that hints at years spent outdoors.

quirks: Always carries a well-worn notebook and pen.
Has a habit of quoting Scottish poets at unexpected moments.
Insists on drinking his tea black, no sugar, even in the sweltering heat of the paddock.
